key_impacts: PHIVOLCS issued tsunami alert level 3 and ordered immediate coastal evacuations.
Estimated 80% of residents in surveyed barangays evacuated after the alert.
No significant tsunami wave occurred and no damages were reported.
Communication problems: delayed/distorted messages, power cuts, mobile outages, and one incorrect radio broadcast.
Warnings reached some areas (e.g., parts of Guiuan) after expected wave arrival time.
evidence_snippets: On 31 August 2012 a strong earthquake occurred; PHIVOLCS issued a tsunami alert shortly after.
All surveyed barangays had an estimated average of 80% of the residents evacuating after the alert.
Most evident for parts of Guiuan; wave travel time ~10 minutes; warning released 14 minutes after the earthquake.
missing_information: No damage or casualty figures; only qualitative impacts reported.
Exact list of affected municipalities beyond Guiuan not specified.
